title: Reaction timer
lastAssistantText:
Zero external references — fully self-contained and offline.

## Summary

I repaired the false-start edge case in `index.html`'s `showSummary()` function.

**The defect:** When a user got 5 consecutive false starts, `finish()` called `showSummary([], true)` with an empty `valid` array. Then:
- `Math.min.apply(null, [])` → `Infinity`
- `Math.max.apply(null, [])` → `-Infinity`
- `avg([])` and stdev → `NaN`

This displayed "Infinity ms", "-Infinity ms", and "NaN ms" in the results panel.

**The fix:** Wrapped the stat computations in an `if (allFalse)` branch. When there are no valid trials, all four stat values (Avg/Best/Worst/Consistency) now render as "–" instead of the broken Infinity/-Infinity/NaN values. The per-trial breakdown (all showing "False start") is unaffected.

**Verified via the real code** using a Node DOM shim:
- 5 consecutive false starts → all stats show "–", no NaN/Infinity in DOM ✓
- Normal run with valid trials → correct avg/best/worst/stdev, no NaN/Infinity ✓ (no regression)

All other verified behaviors preserved (random wait, false-start detection, 5 trials, continue prompt, Space/click input, Test Again button). The single self-contained offline `index.html` remains fully self-contained with zero external references.
